information: Registrations close 17th March 23:59 IST. There will be no on spot registrations for this competition. Please register early to ensure your spot at the competition. Make your payment here under Drishti Cube Open 2017 after reading the payment structure event wise carefully: [PAY HERE](http://www.cubelelo.com/competitions) 2. Register here on the WCA page for this competition under "Register" tab. 3. You will be sent a mail stating that your registration has been accepted once both the above steps have been carried out in order.
